eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

emptyAllocationOf(address).notice: Full configured airdrop redirected to the fixed platform treasury when the signed snapshot has no eligible people.

fundCampaign(bytes32).notice: Reserve prepaid Launcher allocation. The fixed campaign budget cannot be reused.

hashEmptyAllocation(address,address,byte.notice: Explicit root-authority attestation of an empty frozen allocation. No synthetic rights leaf. Chain cannot determine off-chain eligibility: the signer must only authorize a zero-eligible snapshot.

settleEmptyAllocation(address,address,by.notice: Redirect the whole airdrop, once, to the immutable platform treasury. Cannot take reserved rights.
